# METFA Social

> Next-generation Multimodal AI Assistant, Scene Transformation, and Creative Social Ecosystem.

## Overview
METFA Social is a modern, social-first web application and PWA combining community feeds, reels, live streaming, pages, groups, and an AI Studio powered by multimodal Gemini intelligence.

## Core Features
- **Community Feed**: Discover and share posts, AI-generated artworks, recipes, and multimedia with real-time reactions and threaded discussions.
- **AI Studio**: Interactive multimodal canvas for scene transformations, prompt iterations, style presets, and local downloads.
- **Short-form Reels**: Creative video clips with licensed audio tracks and interactive remixing.
- **Live Streaming**: Real-time broadcasts with interactive chat and live audience feedback.
- **Pages & Groups**: Communities, collaborative creator spaces, and interest-based directories.
- **Marketplace**: Dedicated creative and digital marketplace integrations.
- **Universal Profiles & Authentication**: Secure user profiles, customized avatars, bookmark collections, and daily AI credits.
